name: Create Mutator class
summary: Implement a Mutator class in src/mutator.ts to translate transactional JSON into domain commands that mutate IMutable classes. The first action is to define the JSON spec for the fromJson() factory method.

rawActions.name: Define JSON specification for fromJson()
rawActions.summary: Define JSON input spec for Mutator.fromJson(). Top-level operators: $set (Record<string, any>), $push (array of values), $pop (array of indices). One JSON object can have multiple operators: { "$set": { "name": "Joe" }, "$push": { "tags": "tag1" } }. Returns Mutator with commands: Command[] parsed from operators. Throw on unknown operators or malformed input.

rawActions.name: Implement implicit $set logic
rawActions.summary: Implement implicit $set logic in Mutator.fromJson(). Non-$-prefixed top-level keys (excluding id) are implicit $set fields. $-prefixed keys are always meta-properties ($set, $push, $pop, or unknown -> throw); they cannot be used as implicit field names. Implicit fields merge into the same SetCommand as an explicit $set (one SetCommand per Mutator, not two). If a field name appears in both explicit $set and as an implicit key, throw an error (ambiguous, caller must resolve). Example: { id, name: "Joe" } produces a SetCommand with value { name: "Joe" }; { id, $set: { a: 1 }, b: 2 } produces one SetCommand with value { a: 1, b: 2 }; { id, $set: { name: "A" }, name: "B" } throws.

rawActions.name: Implement IMutable and Command hierarchy
rawActions.summary: Implement IMutable interface and Command hierarchy. Command is a data holder: abstract class with public props id (FuzzyId) and value (any). Subclasses: SetCommand(id, Record<string, any>), PushCommand(id, Record<string, any>), PopCommand(id, Record<string, number>). Field information is embedded in value structure. IMutable interface: mutate(cmd: Command): void. Each IMutable class implements mutation logic by inspecting the command type and value structure.
